# Verbi

> Verbi (theverbi.com) is an AI voice recorder and note taker for iPhone and Android. It records meetings, lectures and interviews (Verbi Pro includes 20 hours of transcription a month, MAX 40), transcribes them in 39 languages with automatic language detection, tells the speakers apart (Pro) and writes summaries that stick to what was said.

Several unrelated language-learning apps are also called Verbi. This Verbi is the voice recorder and note taker published at https://theverbi.com: App Store id6752242891 (named Verbi Lecture Recorder & Notes on the US App Store), Google Play package com.monurilgaz.verbi, Instagram @verbi.app.

## Facts

- Platforms: iPhone (App Store) and Android (Google Play). App interface in English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Indonesian, Dutch, Polish and Simplified Chinese (Portuguese and Italian from iOS version 1.4.0 and Android version 1.2.0; Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Indonesian, Dutch, Polish and Chinese from iOS version 1.5.0 and Android version 1.3.0); summaries, titles and chat answers come in the interface language. If the phone’s language is none of these 15, the app shows English; change it under Settings → Language.
- Transcription: 39 languages, among them English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, Japanese and Chinese; auto-detect; live transcription while you speak.
- Input: record in the app, import audio files, share audio from other apps, or paste a YouTube link (regular videos, Shorts, youtu.be).
- Summaries: templates for general meeting, 1:1 meeting, daily meeting, weekly meeting, lesson notes, idea capture, action items, email draft and blog post. Summaries contain only what was said; owners and due dates appear only when someone stated them; suggestions are kept apart from decisions.
- Also: chat with a transcript (Pro), translation into the 15 interface languages (Pro), custom vocabulary, speaker detection with names (Pro), meeting reminders from the calendar, search, copying the text, sharing and export as TXT or PDF (Pro), and a notification when a transcription finishes in the background (Android, and iPhone with iOS 26 or later; on older iOS versions the upload continues in the background and the transcription is ready when the app is reopened).
- Free plan: 60 minutes a month for recordings and imports, recordings kept for 15 days and then deleted, live transcription (basic on iPhone), 3 AI summaries every calendar month (renewed on the 1st; written automatically with the default template, or on request with a template the user picks), and copying the text. On iPhone, a recording stops when the free minutes run out. The app shows any free-plan limit on video-link imports.
- Verbi Pro and MAX (optional subscriptions, price shown in the app): Pro includes 5 hours of transcription a week or 20 hours a month, MAX twice that (10 hours a week or 40 hours a month); plan hours reset every week on weekly plans and every month on monthly and yearly plans, and do not carry over. Both include an automatic AI summary for every transcript with no monthly limit, speaker detection, translation, chat with the transcript, sharing and export (TXT, PDF, audio), high-quality live transcription on iPhone, and recordings kept past 15 days. Extra hours: packs of 5 or 15 hours for subscribers, which never expire.
- Privacy: no account and no cloud sync; recordings and transcripts are stored on the phone. For transcription, audio is sent to ElevenLabs and OpenAI, usually through Verbi’s server; summaries, chat and translation send the transcript text to OpenAI. Usage analytics (Firebase) never include recordings or transcripts and can be turned off in Settings. Details: https://theverbi.com/privacy-policy/
- Verbi does not join video calls as a bot; it records through the phone’s microphone.

- [Transkripsi wawancara di ponsel Anda](https://theverbi.com/id/transkripsi-wawancara/) (id): Rekam wawancara di ponsel atau impor audionya, dan dapatkan transkrip dengan pembicara yang dibedakan, siap dikutip. Verbi untuk iPhone dan Android, 39 bahasa.
- [Interviews transcriberen op je telefoon](https://theverbi.com/nl/interview-transcriberen/) (nl): Neem een interview op je telefoon op of importeer de audio, en krijg een transcript met de sprekers uit elkaar gehouden, klaar om uit te citeren. Verbi voor iPhone en Android, 39 talen.
- [Transkrypcja wywiadów na telefonie](https://theverbi.com/pl/transkrypcja-wywiadow/) (pl): Nagraj wywiad na telefonie lub zaimportuj dźwięk i dostań transkrypcję z rozróżnionymi mówcami, gotową do cytowania. Verbi na iPhone’a i Androida, 39 języków.
- [用手机转写采访](https://theverbi.com/zh/interview-transcription/) (zh): 用手机录下采访或导入音频，得到区分了说话人、便于引用的转写。适用于 iPhone 和 Android 的 Verbi，39 种语言。
- [Turn a YouTube video into text](https://theverbi.com/video-to-text/) (en): Paste a YouTube link into Verbi and get the speech in the video as text, plus a summary if you want one. For iPhone and Android, 39 languages, free to start.
- [YouTube videosunu yazıya çevirme](https://theverbi.com/tr/youtube-videosunu-yaziya-cevirme/) (tr): YouTube linkini Verbi’ye yapıştırın, videodaki konuşmayı metin olarak alın; isterseniz özetini de. iPhone ve Android için, Türkçe dahil 39 dil, ücretsiz başlangıç.
- [YouTube-Video in Text umwandeln](https://theverbi.com/de/youtube-video-in-text/) (de): Füge einen YouTube-Link in Verbi ein und bekomm das Gesprochene im Video als Text, auf Wunsch mit Zusammenfassung. Für iPhone und Android, 39 Sprachen, kostenlos starten.
- [Transformar vídeo do YouTube em texto](https://theverbi.com/pt/video-do-youtube-em-texto/) (pt): Cole um link do YouTube no Verbi e receba a fala do vídeo em texto, com um resumo se quiser. Para iPhone e Android, 39 idiomas, comece grátis.
- [Pasar un video de YouTube a texto](https://theverbi.com/es/pasar-video-de-youtube-a-texto/) (es): Pega un enlace de YouTube en Verbi y obtén en texto lo que se dice en el video, y un resumen si lo quieres. Para iPhone y Android, 39 idiomas, gratis para empezar.
- [Transcrire une vidéo YouTube en texte](https://theverbi.com/fr/transcrire-video-youtube/) (fr): Collez un lien YouTube dans Verbi et récupérez le texte de la vidéo, avec un résumé si vous le souhaitez. iPhone et Android, 39 langues, gratuit pour commencer.
- [Trascrivere un video YouTube in testo](https://theverbi.com/it/video-youtube-in-testo/) (it): Incolla un link di YouTube in Verbi e ottieni il parlato del video come testo, e se vuoi anche un riassunto. Per iPhone e Android, 39 lingue, si parte gratis.
- [حوّل فيديو YouTube إلى نص](https://theverbi.com/ar/video-to-text/) (ar): الصق رابط YouTube في Verbi واحصل على الكلام في الفيديو نصًّا، مع ملخص إن أردت. لـ iPhone وAndroid، و39 لغة، والبدء مجاني.
- [Как перевести видео с YouTube в текст](https://theverbi.com/ru/video-to-text/) (ru): Вставьте ссылку на YouTube в Verbi и получите речь из видео в виде текста, а при желании и резюме. Для iPhone и Android, 39 языков, можно начать бесплатно.
- [YouTube動画をテキストに変換する](https://theverbi.com/ja/video-to-text/) (ja): VerbiにYouTubeのリンクを貼ると、動画の音声がテキストになります。ご希望なら要約も。iPhoneとAndroid対応、39言語、無料で始められます。
- [YouTube 동영상을 텍스트로 변환하기](https://theverbi.com/ko/video-to-text/) (ko): Verbi에 YouTube 링크를 붙여 넣으면 동영상 속 말이 텍스트로 나오고, 원하면 요약도 받을 수 있습니다. iPhone과 Android, 39개 언어, 무료로 시작.
- [Ubah video YouTube menjadi teks](https://theverbi.com/id/video-youtube-ke-teks/) (id): Tempel tautan YouTube ke Verbi dan dapatkan ucapan di video sebagai teks, plus ringkasan jika Anda mau. Untuk iPhone dan Android, 39 bahasa, gratis untuk memulai.
- [Zet een YouTube-video om in tekst](https://theverbi.com/nl/youtube-video-naar-tekst/) (nl): Plak een YouTube-link in Verbi en krijg de spraak uit de video als tekst, plus een samenvatting als je die wilt. Voor iPhone en Android, 39 talen, gratis om te beginnen.
- [Zamień film z YouTube na tekst](https://theverbi.com/pl/film-z-youtube-na-tekst/) (pl): Wklej link do YouTube w Verbi i dostań mowę z filmu jako tekst, a w razie potrzeby także podsumowanie. Na iPhone’a i Androida, 39 języków, na start za darmo.
- [把 YouTube 视频转成文字](https://theverbi.com/zh/video-to-text/) (zh): 把 YouTube 链接粘贴到 Verbi，就能得到视频里说话内容的文字，需要的话还有摘要。支持 iPhone 和 Android，39 种语言，可免费开始。

## Help center

Short answers about how the app works, in 15 languages ([en](https://theverbi.com/help/), [tr](https://theverbi.com/tr/yardim/), [de](https://theverbi.com/de/hilfe/), [pt](https://theverbi.com/pt/ajuda/), [es](https://theverbi.com/es/ayuda/), [fr](https://theverbi.com/fr/aide/), [it](https://theverbi.com/it/assistenza/), [ar](https://theverbi.com/ar/help/), [ru](https://theverbi.com/ru/help/), [ja](https://theverbi.com/ja/help/), [ko](https://theverbi.com/ko/help/), [id](https://theverbi.com/id/bantuan/), [nl](https://theverbi.com/nl/hulp/), [pl](https://theverbi.com/pl/pomoc/), [zh](https://theverbi.com/zh/help/)).

- [How do I transcribe an audio file or a voice memo I already have?](https://theverbi.com/help/transcribe-audio-file/): Tap Upload File in Verbi, or share the file from another app. Audio and video files work; on Pro and MAX the length counts toward your hours.
- [How do I transcribe a WhatsApp or Telegram voice message?](https://theverbi.com/help/transcribe-whatsapp-voice-messages/): Share the voice message from WhatsApp or Telegram to Verbi, then open Verbi. It imports the Opus or Ogg file and turns it into text, on iPhone and Android.
- [How do I turn a YouTube video into text?](https://theverbi.com/help/youtube-video-to-text/): Tap Load from YouTube in Verbi, paste the video’s link and tap Import Video. Verbi fetches the audio and transcribes it; you don’t download anything.
- [How long can a recording be, and does Verbi keep recording with the screen locked?](https://theverbi.com/help/recording-length/): Recording itself isn’t capped; transcribing uses your plan hours (free: 60 minutes a month). It keeps recording with the screen locked, on iPhone and Android.
- [Which languages does Verbi transcribe?](https://theverbi.com/help/languages/): Verbi transcribes 39 languages and can auto-detect them. The app is in 15 languages; summaries use the app’s language.
- [How does live transcription work?](https://theverbi.com/help/live-transcription/): Verbi shows your words as you speak. On iPhone every recording has live text; on Android, use Live Transcription. The final transcript needs internet.
- [Can Verbi tell speakers apart and name them?](https://theverbi.com/help/speaker-detection/): Yes, with Verbi Pro: Verbi labels each voice (Speaker 1, Speaker 2…), and Rename Speakers puts names in the transcript, summary, chat and exports.
- [How do I make Verbi spell names and terms correctly?](https://theverbi.com/help/custom-vocabulary/): Add names, brands and jargon under Settings → Custom Vocabulary. It’s free on every plan, takes up to 100 terms and applies to new recordings.
- [How do I choose a summary template?](https://theverbi.com/help/summary-templates/): Verbi has nine summary templates. Pick one with the template button and tap Generate Summary; the free plan includes 3 summaries a month.
- [Can I ask questions about a recording?](https://theverbi.com/help/ask-questions-about-a-recording/): Yes, with Verbi Pro: tap AI Chat on a recording and ask. Answers come only from the transcript, and the chat says when the answer isn’t there.
- [How do I translate a transcript?](https://theverbi.com/help/translate-transcript/): With Verbi Pro, tap a language in a transcript’s Translation card: English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Indonesian, Dutch, Polish or Simplified Chinese. The original transcript stays.
- [How do I export a transcript (copy, TXT, PDF)?](https://theverbi.com/help/export-transcript/): On the free plan, use Copy Text. Verbi Pro adds sharing the transcript, summary or audio and Export as TXT or PDF (and SRT on iPhone).
- [What does the free plan include, and what does Pro add?](https://theverbi.com/help/free-plan-vs-pro/): Free: 60 minutes a month, recordings kept 15 days, 3 summaries a month. Pro and MAX: transcription hours, summaries, speakers, translation, chat, export.
- [How many hours do Pro and MAX include, and how are they counted?](https://theverbi.com/help/pro-and-max-hours/): Pro and MAX include transcription hours that reset every week or month. Hours are the audio length sent for transcription; unused hours don’t roll over.
- [What happens when my Pro or MAX hours run out?](https://theverbi.com/help/what-happens-when-hours-run-out/): Your recording is kept. The transcription waits until you add extra hours, switch to MAX or your hours reset; Verbi may transcribe the first part now.
- [What are extra hours, and how do they work?](https://theverbi.com/help/extra-hours/): One-time packs of 5 or 15 hours for Pro and MAX. Extra hours never expire and stay yours after you cancel.
- [Where are my recordings stored, and who can see them?](https://theverbi.com/help/privacy-and-storage/): On your phone: Verbi has no account and no cloud sync. Audio is sent to be transcribed and text to OpenAI for AI features; our server doesn’t keep either.
- [How do I cancel Verbi Pro or restore a purchase?](https://theverbi.com/help/cancel-or-restore-subscription/): Cancel Verbi Pro in your App Store or Google Play subscriptions; Verbi has no cancel button. To get Pro back, tap Restore purchases in Verbi.
